verses.text: Not to us, LORD, not to us, but to your name be the glory, because of your faithful love and your truth.
Why should the nations say, "Where is their God now?"
Our God is in heaven. He does whatever he wants.
Their idols are made of silver and gold. Human hands made them.
They have mouths, but cannot speak. They have eyes, but cannot see.
They have ears, but cannot hear. They have noses, but cannot smell.
They have hands, but cannot feel. They have feet, but cannot walk. They cannot make a sound with their throats.
Those who make idols will become like them, and so will everyone who trusts in them.
Israel, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.
Family of Aaron, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.
You who respect the LORD, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.
The LORD remembers us, and he will bless us. He will bless the family of Israel. He will bless the family of Aaron.
He will bless those who respect the LORD, both small and great.
May the LORD give you more and more children, you and your children after you.
May you be blessed by the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
The highest heavens belong to the LORD, but he has given the earth to people.
The dead do not praise the LORD, nor do those who go down into the silent grave.
But we will praise the LORD, now and forever. Praise the LORD!
